apps.name: The Daily TRMNL
apps.scope: Prompt-based news briefing: ten Include/Exclude/Leave out interests, custom interests and place names, automatically composed prompt, real attributed articles, bounded per-prompt history and explicit no-match/outage states. Topic/phrase matching uses public source feeds and optional GDELT search.

apps.name: YC Scout
apps.scope: Sourced YC company discovery, batch verification, launches and sector filters; do not infer YC affiliation from Show HN.

apps.name: Sounds Like My Company
apps.scope: Use company description, customers and category to discover recently launched companies across permitted launch feeds. Explain similarity with cited evidence and distinguish similarity from direct competition.

apps.name: Desk Editor
apps.scope: Off-device editor selects useful sourced cards dynamically, with stable layouts, time-of-day priorities, bounded switching and explicit freshness. Full LLM reasoning depends on an authorized model budget.

apps.name: TRMNL Plays: Tiny Planet
apps.scope: One original shared cooperative world. Each server-verified TRMNL user can make one move per UTC calendar day; aggregate moves are unlimited. Public website shows world and event log; verified ownership is required to move. Durable database and atomic transactions enforce identity and quota. A transparently labeled owner autopilot makes at least one move every day including weekends, through a production scheduler with idempotency and catch-up checks. No client-only or shared-link-only access gate.

apps.name: Game Night Radar
apps.scope: Follow Steam games, show developer updates, patches and announced events, with source links and new-since-previous-edition history.

apps.name: Local Morning Brief
apps.scope: One verified location's local news, weather and transit disruption briefing using reliable supported sources.

executionRules: At most one new app per local weekday; delayed work shifts remaining dates

Daily game operation includes weekends; app development does not
